title: 2009 IEEE International Conference on Multimedia & Expo (ICME 2009)
text: From June 28th to July 3th, we assist at the ICME2009 conference. This year, this conference is held at the Waldorf=Astoria hotel , in New York, USA.

title: The 2009 World Congress in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, and Applied Computing (WORLDCOMP’09)
text: From July 13th to July 16th, 2009, we attend at The 2009 International Conference on Image Processing, Computer Vision, and Pattern Recognition (IPCV09), in the WorldComp conference . The conference is held at the Monte Carlo Resort , Las Vegas, USA.

title: Fourth CVC Workshop on the Progress of Research & Development (CVCRD 2009)
text: We are organizing the Fourth CVC Workshop , which will be held in the Computer Vision Center the October 30th, 2009. This year, the main track of the workshop is to explore the New Trends and Challenges in Computer Vision . The deadline for submission is October 3th.
